name: Blueground
description:
Blueground is a global proptech company that is reinventing the way people live!

With its curated network of thousands of quality, turnkey homes in sought-after neighborhoods around the globe, Blueground is accessible for stays of a month or longer. Our tech-enabled platform provides a fully digitized experience with around-the-clock support and access to daily necessities like apartment cleanings, grocery delivery, wellness offerings, and more, providing a seamless experience from end to end.

At Blueground, our mission is to make people feel at home wherever they choose to live. We give guests peace of mind, flexibility & the confidence they need to explore life’s next adventure. Our team, known as the BeeGees, shares this spirit. We foster a culture of curiosity, connection, and growth. We empower each BeeGee to make an impact, championing a workplace where innovation thrives, careers flourish, and every individual is supported in shaping their own journey.

Blueground is headquartered in New York City, with a portfolio of thousands of apartments in 46+ cities and 17 countries worldwide.

Find us on Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok or at www.theblueground.com.

  • Strong communication skills—both written and verbal

If you’re ready to do the best work of your life and help reshape how the world lives, we’d love to meet you.

The Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Operations Lead to join our fast-growing team in New York, NY. This field-based role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving problems, leading by example, and ensuring every property meets the highest standards of quality and guest satisfaction.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Property Turnovers: Oversee the full apartment preparation process—from coordinating housekeeping and maintenance teams to conducting detailed inspections before guest check-ins.
  • Own Onsite Readiness: Assemble furniture, troubleshoot WiFi and tech setups, and carry out small repairs to ensure every apartment meets our standards before move-in.
  • Field Coordination & Team Supervision: Act as the go-to person in the field, managing relationships with external vendors, housekeeping staff, and building personnel to ensure seamless operations.
  • Perform Quality Control: Conduct thorough property inspections using mobile checklists, flag issues, and ensure that every space meets our cleanliness, functionality, and design expectations.
  • Hands-On Support: Step in to help with urgent needs—whether that’s swapping out furniture, fixing appliances, delivering essentials, or solving guest lockouts.
  • Drive Efficiency: Manage and maintain our corporate vans and inventory stock, ensuring supplies and tools are always available and organized.

Each day begins at the office, where you pick up your equipped "Pit Stop Van" before heading out into the city. Your tasks are clearly scheduled, ensuring efficiency as you complete 3–4 full unit turns. Upon arriving at each unit, you conduct a detailed inspection, addressing any maintenance needs, assisting with some housekeeping alongside the cleaning team, and preparing the space for the next guest. Whether troubleshooting appliances, replacing keys, or refreshing paint, every step ensures the unit meets high-quality standards. Once the first unit is ready, you drive to the next property and repeat the process, adapting to each location’s unique needs. Throughout the day, you coordinate logistics, problem-solve on-site challenges, and maintain a smooth workflow. Finally, after completing all scheduled turns, you return the van to the office, wrapping up a productive day of ensuring seamless guest experiences.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of experience in a supervisory or team lead role—ideally in field ops, facilities, hospitality, or housekeeping
  • Comfortable performing basic handyman tasks and minor repairs
  • Physically capable of lifting 30Ibs and being active for most of the workday
  • Tech-savvy—familiar with tools like Slack, G Suite, and mobile apps
  • Strong communicator with a customer-first mindset and a positive, can-do attitude
  • A flexible team player who thrives in a dynamic, constantly evolving environment

Additional Requirements:

  • Availability to work SAT/SUN/MON 
  • Valid driver’s license 
  • Ability to drive a company van-sized vehicle 
  • Access to a reliable vehicle (DC/SEA/LA/SF/SAN) with mileage reimbursement

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and annual performance bonus ($65,000 - $74,500 per year + performance bonus)
  • Handheld device stipend 
  • Flexible PTO
  • Cigna Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • 401k retirement plan
  • Paid maternity/parental leave benefits for new parents
  • Complimentary accommodation in Blueground locations. Think summer in Greece and winter in Dubai!

About the Role

We are looking for a Sales Admin based in Brazil to support our sales team by owning the administrative and client-facing steps that take a booking from signed to moved in.

The Sales Admin is responsible for managing pre-move-in client communications, completing guest screening and background requirements, coordinating arrivals, and setting up bookings accurately in our internal systems. This role works closely with sales, housing sourcing, and operations teams while serving as a reliable point of contact for clients and guests.

If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrive on keeping many moving pieces on track in a fast-paced environment, this role may be a great fit.

What you will focus on

  • Own pre move-in client communications, including sending move-in hand-off emails with everything clients and guests need before arrival
  • Manage background requirements by generating background documentation and sending it to clients for review
  • Follow up with clients and guests to ensure background checks are completed on time
  • Locate and route background documents through the correct e-signature workflow
  • Screen guests through SafeRent Solutions and track results to completion
  • Coordinate pet and parking registrations with clients and property partners
  • Communicate changes of date (COD), changes of address (COA), and cancellations with clients, keeping all parties aligned
  • Run daily arrivals audits to confirm upcoming bookings are complete, accurate, and move-in ready
  • Send manual arrivals emails when automated communications don't apply
  • Set up bookings in BlueB, including creating buildings, properties (POs), and Deal Sheet (DS) records
  • Maintain accurate records across internal systems so sales, sourcing, and operations teams have up-to-date information
  • Partner with internal teams to resolve issues quickly and deliver a smooth move-in experience for every guest
  • Sense of Urgency & Prioritization: Ability to effectively prioritize competing tasks in a fast-paced environment, with client communication and time-sensitive requests taking priority.
  • Client Advocacy & Problem-Solving: Proactively explore alternative solutions and available options to achieve the best possible outcomes for clients while ensuring their needs remain the top priority.

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales support, administration, corporate housing, hospitality, real estate, property management, or a related field
  • Exceptional organizational skills and ability to manage multiple bookings and deadlines simultaneously
  • High attention to detail when processing documents, screenings, and system entries
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills with clients and guests
  • Strong follow-through and ability to keep tasks moving without close supervision
  • Familiarity with tenant screening, background checks, or lease/onboarding paperwork is a plus
  • Proficiency in Google suite and comfort learning internal systems for data entry and tracking
  • Proactive, solution-oriented mindset and ability to move quickly in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
jobs.description:
🌍 Redefining how people live

At Blueground, we believe that when your base is reliable, the world opens up. That’s why we’re building the world’s leading platform for living.

Every year, over 350 million people move between cities — yet today’s housing options haven’t kept up with the needs of a modern, mobile generation. Blueground was created to change that.

With 60,000+ homes around the world, available for stays from a few days to a year or more, we’re only just getting started. We’re on an ambitious growth path to redefine living and create an entirely new category. Our edge? Powerful proprietary technology, operational excellence, and a team that moves with speed and discipline.

Our Culture Is Anchored In Five Principles 

✨ Guests First – Every decision starts with their experience.

⚡ Move Fast – We value momentum and action.

🔍 Dive In – The magic is in the details, and we go deep.

🔄 Embrace Change – Change isn’t disruption; it’s how we grow.

🤝 Keep It Honest – Transparency accelerates progress and strengthens relationships.

If you’re ready to do the best work of your life and help reshape how the world lives, we’d love to meet you.

🔑 About the Role

We're looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to join Blueground's Client-Facing Mobile team and help shape the future of the guest experience.

Our mobile app is one of Blueground's most strategic products, accompanying guests throughout their entire journey—from discovering and booking their next home to managing every aspect of their stay. As we continue to invest heavily in our technology platform, we're redesigning our post-booking experience from the ground up while expanding the app to cover the complete booking journey, making it the primary touchpoint for thousands of guests every day.

As part of the team, you'll build high-quality native iOS experiences using modern technologies and engineering practices, collaborating closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers to deliver features that are intuitive, reliable, and delightful to use. You'll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, improve the architecture of our mobile platform, and contribute to a product that directly impacts our guests every day.

We're looking for product-minded engineers who care as much about the user experience as they do about clean architecture and code quality. You'll thrive here if you enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines, and building polished experiences that solve real customer problems.

We're also embracing AI as part of our engineering culture—both in the products we build and in the way we work. We actively use modern AI-assisted development tools to help us move faster, automate repetitive work, and focus on delivering meaningful value to our users.

Our Stack

  • Swift & SwiftUI
  • Design System & Design Tokens
  • Accessibility-first development (iOS Accessibility)
  • Internationalization (i18n) & Localization
  • Offline-first architecture powered by Core Data
  • MVVM-C architecture with Dependency Injection (DI)
  • CI/CD with Fastlane, Bitrise & GitHub Actions
  • Payment integrations including Stripe, Adyen, and Revolut
  • Mobile observability & analytics with Datadog, Firebase, Bitly, and Braze
  • Automated regression testing with Unit, Functional, and End-to-End (E2E) tests
  • AI-assisted development using Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot

Our code sits on GitHub, is built, tested, and packaged via GitHub Actions, and runs on Kubernetes. We manage projects in JIRA, our prototypes and mockups in Figma, and monitor our systems and performance in Datadog, with the help of Resolve.ai.

What you'll do

  • Work on services supporting our customer-facing web and mobile apps
  • Create exceptional experiences in our customer-facing iOS app
  • Use AI tooling for most, if not all, of your tasks
  • Write your unit tests
  • Automate stuff. Like a lot.
  • Be religious with Git
  • Depend on a CI pipeline and world-class telemetry.
  • Experiment, learn, and have fun

What to expect

  • To work in a small, agile, data-driven, customer-obsessed, multi-cultural team
  • To roll up your sleeves and dive into the details
  • To fully embrace the AI change
  • To enjoy some quality engineering on a multitude of technologies
  • A rapidly growing company
  • Cool and helpful colleagues :)

Interview Process

  • Dialogue with Talent Acquisition Team (30m)
  • Live Coding: Evaluating Coding skills (90m)
  • Tech Dialogue: CS skills (90m)
  • System Design & Executive Dialogue (60m)

Requirements

  • 3+ years of full-time industry experience working on iOS
  • A deep understanding of the iOS SDK
  • Strong platform fundamentals (SwiftUI, CoreData, Xcode instruments)
  • Strong CS background
  • Strong Swift skills
  • Testing mindset and an eye for clean code
  • An eye for good UX
  • Really comfortable with Git
  • Excellent communication in English
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or a related subject

Pay, Perks, and Such

  • Competitive salary
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive group health insurance
  • Access to training budget and resources
  • Access to premium AI-powered productivity tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT)
  • Mobile data plan
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • A dynamic, collaborative environment with talented people
  • Flexibility to work remotely through our Blueground Nomads mobility program
  • Complimentary accommodation at Blueground locations
  • A culture that embraces Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at its core

Learn more about Blueground at https://theblueground.com. To keep up with Blueground news, follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok! To get a feeling of how we think about tech, make sure you check our Engineering Blog!

You'll work in an exciting and collaborative environment, surrounded by talented and motivated colleagues.

What You Will Focus On:

  • Leadership & Oversight: Manage and mentor a team of warehouse associates, including warehouse pickers and the box truck driver/packer. Provide clear direction, training, and feedback to maintain high operational standards and ensure seamless integration during peak periods.

  • Decision-Making: Solve problems, make sound decisions, and prioritize assignments in a fast-paced and constantly evolving warehouse environment.

  • 3+ years of experience in a warehouse lead or supervisory role managing hourly employees.
